mode: Persistent ordinary PostgreSQL VIEW in the pinned native UTF-8 profiles.

CreateView.role: A persistent ordinary view declaration with exact output identities and catalog policies.
CreateView.structure: An absolute view name, checked SELECT or VALUES, nonempty effective heading, replacement flag, optional security barrier and invoker flags and the write check policy.
CreateView.conditions: Require an exact width, distinct case-sensitive PostgreSQL names, supported unbounded body with no parameters and a persistent source if any. Apply CHECK OPTION only to a simple base-table projection. Reject direct self-reference and temporary schema identities.
CreateView.meaning: Declare the named view with a live query, ordered heading and native read and write settings. Replacement preserves the object's native identity and validates the existing heading at evaluation.
CreateView.sql: Publish the actual resolved heading and source, explicit policy options if supplied, and the native CHECK OPTION clause.

ViewCheckOption.role: The write visibility policy of a PostgreSQL view.
ViewCheckOption.conditions: An explicit policy requires the checked simple base-table view role.
ViewCheckOption.meaning: Determine whether the view's own filter, and any filters inherited under the native cascade rule, are enforced on writes.
ViewCheckOption.sql: Omit an absent policy and emit WITH LOCAL CHECK OPTION or WITH CASCADED CHECK OPTION for an explicit policy.

structure: An immutable declaration combines a live query, full catalog heading, qualified identity and native security and replacement policy.
conditions: Admit persistent ordinary views with independently valid standalone VALUES or a checked plain SELECT with no source or one resolved persistent base source. Keep the admitted default, explicit true and explicit false security options. Accept a partial output aliases list in analysis by completing it with resolved heading names. Disallow parameters, recursive and temporary views, self references, duplicate column names and unsupported definition placements.
meaning: Create or replace a live ordinary view with stable output identities and data types. Native catalog collisions and an incompatible replacement are state-dependent errors. Explicit write checks constrain inserts or updates through a simple updatable view. A rollback reverses the catalog and data effects.
sql: Use the absolute view identity and full quoted heading, replay the parameter-free body, preserve whether each security flag was specified, and emit the selected check policy.
observations: Native view kind, output names, order, type OIDs and data rows before and after a base update
Catalog option presence and typed settings including explicit false
Exact status and SQLSTATE for new, colliding and incompatible replacement
Runtime view write acceptance or rejection of a row excluded by the predicate, with its actual base-table effect
Same-name view in an independent schema, transaction status and restored catalog and data after rollback

finite.completeness: Read replacement, body role and both option operands from the loaded graph. Verify each independent catalog fixture and exhaust the declared Cartesian product.

analysis: Declaration with a partially supplied heading
Declaration with both security flags including explicit false
Live view defined over a typed null and duplicate VALUES

LOCAL CHECK OPTION through a filtered base projection

writeProbes: Base filter with absent, LOCAL and CASCADED write policy
negative: Heading width differs from the body
An inapplicable check option on a VALUES definition

exploration.requiredForms: Vary the definition graph, column positions, body filtering, literal shape, security options, fixture collisions, and eligible write-check policies.

faults: Admit a repeated effective column name

evidence.P01: Retain resolved view and source identities, native body roles, column positions and clause choices.
evidence.P02: Reject invalid persistent scope, headings, parameter placement and check-policy combinations.
evidence.P03: Store only native view meaning and a checked query, independent of parse facts.
evidence.P04: Combine query meaning, effective heading and fixed catalog policies.
evidence.P05: Use detached ordered immutable headings and checked child values.
evidence.P06: Emit a complete native declaration whose reads and write checks agree with the typed value.
evidence.Q01: Check distinct boundary reductions and the fixed invalid cases.
evidence.Q02: Exhaust the direct finite domain and accept independently authored examples.
evidence.Q03: Use the independent fixture evaluator for view creation, replacement, live reads and writes.
evidence.Q04: Compare actual native metadata, preserved rows, exact SQLSTATE and transaction effects.
evidence.Q05: Connect direct and analyzed clauses to exact distributed PHP and native observations.

open: Recursive, temporary and materialized view declaration roles
General joins, CTEs, compound, grouped and bounded view definitions
Definer privileges, grants and security barrier behavior with user-defined functions
Updatable views over another view and possible trigger or rule interactions
trust: Truthful static model of the persistent input relation and execution profile
Independent typed catalog and transactional observer
